notes: with the custom palette stored, #zct-ui-root resolves --zct-accent=#3ba7ff through the stylesheet rule that derives it from the inherited page token, with no inline override; F1.custom-ui-root-accent-after-control-write checks that the panel control write reaches it, and F2.no-inline-accent-override checks that returning to the shipped accent leaves no leftover override.

environmentFacts.fact: this Electron build allowed AudioContext.resume() without user activation, so the classic Chromium autoplay block did not reproduce on this machine
environmentFacts.consequence: the unlock path (data-locked "1" -> "0", which by the audio.ts chain means AudioContext.state === "running") is verified; the branch where a stricter build keeps the context suspended until a real user gesture remains untested here and would be recorded as NOT TESTED by C16.lock-clears-after-gesture

environmentFacts.fact: the 1440x900 CSS viewport was reached with a real SetWindowPos resize of the isolated window, at devicePixelRatio 1.75
environmentFacts.consequence: screenshots are 2520x1575 PNGs of that viewport; no emulation was used

environmentFacts.fact: the palette checks drove POST /api/prefs with background #0b1020 and accent #3ba7ff (wallpaperVisible=false), the light-background check used #f2ece0, and the greeting checks used custom text before restoring the text observed at start
environmentFacts.consequence: screenshots 01-07 were captured before this phase, so they show an uncustomised install; 08 and 09 are the customised captures. The inline --zct-accent on #zct-ui-root is proven through the panel control path because an external POST does not refresh the client's in-memory prefs (see notes)
